properties.title: mcp-guard M1 상관 규칙 경보 상태
최근 상관 규칙 경보 (correlation_alert)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/mcp-guard/audit' | filter event_type = "correlation_alert"
| fields @timestamp, details.severity, details.rule_id, details.message, session_id, server_name, tool_name
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

properties.title: 규칙별 경보 수
properties.query:
SOURCE '/mcp-guard/audit' | filter event_type = "correlation_alert"
| stats count(*) as alerts by details.rule_id

properties.title: 차단된 판정 (block)
properties.query:
SOURCE '/mcp-guard/audit' | filter verdict = "block"
| stats count(*) as blocks by event_type, server_name
| sort blocks desc
